title: Why the operating room is ripe for AI, according to Akara

author: Russell Brandom, Theresa Loconsolo

title: Waymo is testing Gemini as an in-car AI assistant in its robotaxis
description: Waymo is testing a Gemini-powered in-car AI assistant, per findings from a 1,200-line system prompt. The assistant can answer general knowledge questions, control certain in-cabin features, and more.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Italy tells Meta to suspend its policy that bans rival AI chatbots from WhatsApp
description: Italy has ordered Meta to suspend its policy that bans companies from using WhatsApp's business tools to offer their own AI chatbots on the popular chat app.
author: Ram Iyer

title: John Carreyrou and other authors bring new lawsuit against six major AI companies
description: These authors rejected Anthropic's class action settlement, arguing that "LLM companies should not be able to so easily extinguish thousands upon thousands of high-value claims at bargain-basement rates."
author: Amanda Silberling

title: Marissa Mayer’s new startup Dazzle raises $8M led by Forerunner’s Kirsten Green
description: Mayer launched Dazzle after shuttering her photo and contact management startup Sunshine. Green’s investment suggests Dazzle is poised for the coming wave of new AI-infused consumer businesses.
author: Marina Temkin

title: Amazon’s AI assistant Alexa+ now works with Angi, Expedia, Square, and Yelp
description: The new integrations join other services like Yelp, Uber, OpenTable and others.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Lemon Slice nabs $10.5M from YC and Matrix to build out its digital avatar tech
description: Digital avatar generation company Lemon Slice is working to add a video layer to AI chatbots with a new diffusion model that can create digital avatars from a single image.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: OpenAI says AI browsers may always be vulnerable to prompt injection attacks
description: OpenAI says prompt injections will always be a risk for AI browsers with agentic capabilities, like Atlas. But the firm is beefing up its cybersecurity with an "LLM-based automated attacker."
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Alphabet to buy Intersect Power to bypass energy grid bottlenecks
description: Alphabet is set to pay $4.75 billion in cash, plus debt, for the data center and clean energy developer.
author: Marina Temkin

author: Sarah Perez

description: Waymo suspended its SF robotaxi service on Saturday evening after a massive blackout appeared to leave many of its vehicles stalled on city streets.

description: The bill will require large AI developers to publish information about their safety protocols and report safety incidents to the state within 72 hours.
author: Anthony Ha

description: The round was led by Lightspeed Venture Partners, according to people familiar with the deal.

description: Renowned AI scientist Yann LeCun confirmed on Thursday the worst-kept secret in the tech world: that he had indeed launched a new startup. Although he did say he will not be running the new company as its CEO.
author: Julie Bort

title: OpenAI adds new teen safety rules to ChatGPT as lawmakers weigh AI standards for minors
description: OpenAI updated its guidelines for how its AI models should behave with users under 18, and published new AI literacy resources for teens and parents. Still, questions remain about how well policies translate into practice.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Known uses voice AI to help you go on more in-person dates

author: Ivan Mehta

title: Meta is developing a new image and video model for a 2026 release, report says
description: Meta aims to make the text-based model better at coding while also exploring new world models that understand visual information and can reason, plan, and act without needing to be trained on every possibility.
author: Ivan Mehta

description: The ChatGPT maker is aiming to raise the funding by the end of the first quarter in 2026, and the company may ask sovereign wealth funds to invest in the round.
